notes: Own site (mystic-grill.com) has no working menu: its 'Food & Drink' page is unfinished leftover Avada theme demo content (fake $14.95 English-Asparagus/Sea-Trout items, a fictional NYC/London 'Avada Cafe', placeholder address '12345 North Main Street, NY'), and the 'ORDER ONLINE' popup never resolves past a loading spinner. The site's own Square link (mystic-grill.square.site) is likewise a demo: it serves a UK burger/pizza menu priced in GBP (Tomato Bread £4.95 etc.) that has nothing to do with this restaurant. With no first- or second-tier source usable, fell back to this DoorDash storefront, matched to the correct address (6990 University Ave, La Mesa) and explicitly labeled by DoorDash itself as 'Prices on this menu are set directly by the Merchant' (not an unaffiliated/estimated listing). Extracted from the page's own embedded schema.org Menu/MenuItem JSON-LD (avoids DoorDash's virtualized on-screen list truncating). Prices are ordinary POS-style numbers (mostly .99, with cheap outliers like a $2.50 dessert) rather than a delivery-platform markup pattern, which is corroborating but not conclusive — hence medium rather than high. Sections captured: Appetizers 1-11, Salads 12-22, Sandwiches/Wraps/Rolls 23-29, Pastas 30-36, Fresh Seafood 47-54, Entrée-Kabobs 56-60, Entrée-Shawarma Plates 61-66, Dessert 67-70, Pizza 46.
